data.name: Aadilaan
data.gender_notes: Aadilaan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: An extended form of Arabic ʿādil (عادل) 'just, fair', from the root ʿ-d-l (justice). The extended ending is a name-form variation rather than a separate lexical word. Aadilaan therefore means “Just; fair (variant form of Aadil)”. Extended form of Arabic ʿādil 'just, fair'; from the root ʿ-d-l.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadilaan expresses “Just”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

faq.q: How does Aadilaan relate to Aadil?
faq.a: Aadilaan is an extended form of the Arabic name ʿādil (عادل) 'just, fair'. It shares the same root ʿ-d-l (justice); the longer ending is a name-form variation.

faq.q: What does the name Aadilaan mean?
faq.a: Aadilaan means “Just; fair (variant form of Aadil)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aadilaan come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadilaan?
faq.a: The root of Aadilaan is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadilaan written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadilaan is written عادلان in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadilaan a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadilaan is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aadilaan appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadilaan is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadilaan verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just; fair (variant form of Aadil)” is established by Extended form of Arabic ʿādil 'just, fair'; from the root ʿ-d-l..
